notes.title: Update - Various Patches and Controller Tweaks.
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

  Thanks for all the comments on the community hub and for all of your support!

  Changes made in this update include: Fixes for various issues with key binding for left shift, delete, enter, N, V and some other key combinations that were not working completely before.
  A bug with multiplayer input not working properly has also been fixed.
  Various other bugs have also been fixed!

  Please reach out to us on the threads if you experience any technical issues.

notes.title: Update - Controllers And Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Hello all,

[h1]IMPORTANT NOTE - PLEASE READ![/h1]
You will need to delete your config folder for this update to work.
[list]
[*]Go to [b]SteamApps\common\E.T. Armies\UDKGame[/b] and delete the [b]Config[/b] folder.
[*]Reload Steam.
[*]Right click on the game in your [b]Library[/b], click [b]Properties[/b]. Select the [b]LOCAL FILES[/b] tab. Click [b]VERIFY INTEGRITY OF GAME CACHE...[/b]
[*]Your config files will be re-downloaded.
[/list]

Following all of the great feedback we received on the Community Hub; The new update for E.T. Armies is ready. Besides some minor bug fixes, this update mostly address key binding and controller issues. We hope you find this update useful.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added more keys to the input system, including numpad keys, arrow keys, Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Tab, Caps Lock, Spacebar and mouse thumb keys.
[*]Added more functions in input system for better customization.
[*]Added toggle options for crouch and sprint.
[*]Added partial gamepad support for Xbox 360 controllers. Please note that the controller only supports toggle crouch and toggle sprint. You can play with other controllers too but you should use external programs to map the keys.
[*]Added invert X and Y option for both controller and mouse.
[*]Fixed the issue where V-sync was not working. If you change this option in settings you need to restart the game to make it take effect.
[/list]

Here you can see the picture of new input setting window.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/BitGxzF.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/PGjjXRu.jpg[/img]

We will keep an eye on these changes to make sure they work properly. As always, feedback and comments are very welcome.

Thank you all for your patience and support!

notes.title: An In-Depth Look at the Story of E.T. Armies
notes.content:
[h1]An Update on Beta Testing[/h1]
We have been reading all your comments asking for beta access on the previous announcement.
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/382420/announcements/detail/645508804895029351]http://steamcommunity.com/games/382420/announcements/detail/645508804895029351[/url]
You can still register your interest there, we will choose testers at random on [b]February 26th[/b] remember to follow the store page and leave a comment to let us know you’re interested.

[h1]Back Story[/h1]
So a lot of you have expressed interest in the narrative and single player campaign, so we have put together this announcement for you to sink your teeth into some back story!

Check out the intro cutscene here (click on the banner to reveal):
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WHJnuCc2o2E
Long ago, Earth was the only home to mankind, a planet filled with life, energy and resources. But some were not satisfied with what they had. They wanted more and more. And they didn’t care about killing their own kin to achieve their goal, they began to wage war to take what they wanted. That war was long, and the last war on our dear planet.
The Earth was no longer a place to live, but a ruin that was left from brutal war. All nations decided to leave Earth to find new planets, to find new homes and new resources. They left the Earth. But not all could leave. There were many poor, weak and abandoned people around the world who could not afford the technology to leave the Earth, and they certainly did not accept the help of those who they once fought against.
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/AqX7OXv.jpg[/img]

Years have passed after that and many have died, but some survived. They mysteriously began to adapt themselves to the new environment. And it became clear for them that they should now join their forces to fight for their survival. They became united and built an empire, an empire that was known by others as “Forsaken”.
Although it was a new dawn for Forsakens, they did not forget one thing; the hatred for others who abandoned them to rot in that pit. They wanted revenge, they wanted everything that was taken from them, and for that they needed power. They started to invade other planets to steal their resources. They didn’t care who they are, they didn’t care what they believed, they just started massacres one after another to achieve their goals.
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/BGGPyTg.jpg[/img]

Many thought of Forsakens as poor nation who needed other’s help to survive, but they were naive, those time are long gone. And now it is time; time to face their brutal rampage. A soldier’s duty is to protect his people, is to defend against any threat.

notes.title: E.T. Armies - Environments!
notes.content:
What would a First Person Shooter be without some amazing maps to run around and use for cover and vantage points? Fans of the genre know well that you can find advantage with a keen strategy and strong knowledge of a map.

E.T. Armies features various environments across each level with unique and detailed atmospheres. Here we will show you the 3 main areas that you will play during the campaign mode.
 
[h1]The Ruins[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/szHwBqB.gif[/img]
A mysterious abandoned desert, Inspired by Persepolis architecture. This was the first place to be struck down by the forsaken; Their invasion originated from these ruins. It is now mostly destroyed but there are still some remnants of forsakens here and there.
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/krKjbou.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Refinery[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/BlIuXQI.gif[/img]

An old factory built very far from the cities. This refinery was built to extract a special essence from a mysterious crystal, the main power resource of the planet. The refinery is separated into two areas, the exterior, similar to an ordinary factory, and the inner section, built around the core of the mysterious crystals. There are also large reactors and generators that use the crystal to power the refinery itself.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/HxdBwDC.jpg[/img]
 
[h1]The Hidden Fort[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/fxU5uTp.gif[/img]

An unknown structure built on top of the crystals ores. This structure was the primary experimental device extracting power from the liquid crystal. Below the structure, the ground is rich in raw material, ready to be extracted for power generation.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/meWzEct.jpg[/img]

notes.title: E.T. Armies Discussion FAQs
notes.content:
What are your thoughts on [b]E.T. Armies[/b]? Reach out to us on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/382420/discussions/]Community Hub[/url] and we'll get back to you with any info! We'll continue updating the FAQs over on the Hub, so be sure to follow the store page for updates!

[h1]Will the game only be available for Windows?[/h1]
E.T. Armies will be available for PCs running Microsoft Windows XP and higher.

[h1]How much will the game cost?[/h1]
The US price at launch will be $14.99 with a nice launch discount! Be sure to follow the Store page to take advantage of the deal!

[h1]Will there be a single player campaign?[/h1]
Yes, E.T Armies features a full single player campaign.

[h1]What type of muliplayer is available?[/h1]
E.T. Armies will be launched with peer to peer multiplayer. You can create or join games and play with friends. We are considering dedicated servers and matchmaking systems along with other updates if we see lots of interest in these options. Be sure to express your interest in the threads!

[h1]Will the game feature a Persian-Farsi language option?[/h1]
As the game was created in the UDK, right->left text will not be available.
Voice acting will take time, to cover the game in its entirety. If we see lots of interest for this option, this could be prioritized for a patch so be sure to let us know in the discussions!

We'll be sure to read all comments, so get in touch with us on the Discussions boards!

notes.title: Welcome to E.T. Armies!
notes.content:
Apologies for the lack of updates since our [url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/extraterrestrial-armies-et-armies/]IndieDB[/url] announcements, We've been working hard on the game and polishing it up, and since many people also asked for multiplayer while we were in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=178807065]Greenlight[/url], we've been working very hard to implement it. Now, finally we're ready to publish to Steam!  Get in touch on the forums with your thoughts on E.T Armies as it approaches release!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/x4Y8LBN.jpg[/img]

[h1]Back Story[/h1]

In a distant future, mankind has located and inhabited new planets. As the new world begins to expand, humanity’s hunger for power and new resources intensifies. Although many new planets are found, Earth has fallen and has been left uninhabitable. Abandoning Earth seemed to be the only guarantee for survival. However, not all could leave. Those left behind became united and formed a nation to fight for their survival on the doomed planet. But it’s all just a beginning for these forsaken, a beginning to their devastating plan for vengeance. A massive onslaught that must be stopped, by all means necessary.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/u2UA81k.gif[/img]

[b]A note to all Steam users[/b] - E.T. Armies will have a complete multiplayer mode via Steam and LAN! Play against your friends online as you master each environment to gain an advantage.
